issues.description: The authorization resolution restricts appointment management exclusively to salon staff/admins ('salon staff/admins can manage appointments... Customers can manage their own profiles and bookings'), which semantically conflicts with REQ-005 granting customers the permission to cancel appointments.
issues.suggested_question: Can customers directly cancel their own appointments, or must cancellation requests be processed/managed exclusively by salon staff?

issues.description: The system resolution dictates that the system requires authentication and role-based authorization, but REQ-002 allows viewing available services prior to or independent of customer registration (REQ-001), creating a contradiction over whether browsing services requires an authenticated session.
issues.suggested_question: Is viewing available services publicly accessible to unauthenticated visitors, or is authentication required before viewing services?
